words.enDefinition: to distribute or assign a share of something

examples.en: The trustee will allot the shares to each heir once probate closes.
examples.zh: 遗嘱认证一结束，受托人就会把股份「按规定分配」给每位继承人。

examples.en: HR will allot the new hires across three teams based on their skills.
examples.zh: 人事部会按技能把新员工「分配」到三个团队。

words.enDefinition: a ship or aircraft that carries freight

examples.en: The freighter docked at Mombasa a day early, so customs worked a weekend shift.
examples.zh: 「货轮」提前一天靠泊蒙巴萨，海关只好周末加班。

examples.en: A charter freighter flew the vaccine pallets straight into the highlands.
examples.zh: 一架包租的「货机」把疫苗托板直接送进了高原地区。

words.enDefinition: an accounting method that combines companies by pooling equity interests

examples.en: The textbook case contrasts pooling-of-interest accounting with the purchase method.
examples.zh: 教科书案例对比了「权益结合法」与购买法的处理。

examples.en: Regulators scrapped pooling-of-interest treatment after too many acquisitions dodged goodwill.
examples.zh: 由于太多并购借机规避商誉确认，监管机构废除了「权益结合法」。

words.enDefinition: a cost incurred after the main transaction or production stage

examples.en: Buyers rarely budget for the after-cost of maintenance once the machine is theirs.
examples.zh: 买家很少为设备到手后的「后续成本」预留预算。

examples.en: The winning bid hid its after-cost in thin service contracts.
examples.zh: 中标方案把「后续成本」藏在了单薄的服务合同里。

words.enDefinition: designed or organised mainly for export markets

examples.en: The province favors export-oriented factories with tax breaks and faster customs.
examples.zh: 该省对「面向出口的」工厂给予税收减免和快速通关待遇。

examples.en: Export-oriented growers switched crops when the euro weakened against the dollar.
examples.zh: 欧元对美元走软后，「出口导向型」种植户更换了作物。

words.enDefinition: failure to pay an amount that is due

examples.en: Two consecutive months of non-payment put the tenant on the eviction list.
examples.zh: 连续两个月的「不支付」让这位租户上了驱逐名单。

examples.en: The clause treats non-payment of dues as automatic suspension of membership.
examples.zh: 条款规定，「不缴会费」即自动中止会员资格。

words.enDefinition: a joint venture formed by contract rather than by creating a new company

examples.en: Their contractual-joint-venture lets the partners split profits without forming a company.
examples.zh: 他们的「契约式联合经营」让双方分成利润而无需成立公司。

examples.en: Lawyers drafted the contractual-joint-venture around the port concession terms last winter.
examples.zh: 律师围绕港口特许权条款起草了这份「契约式合营」安排。

words.enDefinition: pressure or drive to increase profits

examples.en: Analysts blame profit-push pressure for the shortcuts found in the plant's records.
examples.zh: 分析师认为，工厂记录中的偷工减料源于「追求利润」的压力。

examples.en: Wage claims fed a profit-push spiral through the whole industry.
examples.zh: 工资诉求在整个行业引发了一轮「利润推动」的螺旋上涨。

words.enDefinition: an arrangement to share costs and benefits among parties

examples.en: The memorandum sets out cost-and-benefit-sharing for the shared irrigation canal.
examples.zh: 备忘录明确了共用灌渠的「成本与收益分摊」办法。

examples.en: Disputes over cost-and-benefit-sharing stalled the toll road project for months.
examples.zh: 「成本与收益分摊」的争议使收费公路项目停滞数月。

words.enDefinition: the assessed ability and willingness to repay credit

examples.en: The landlord checked her credit-worthiness twice before handing over the keys.
examples.zh: 房东在交钥匙之前，两次核查了她的「信用可靠性」。

examples.en: Trade insurers rate our credit-worthiness higher than last year's filing suggested.
examples.zh: 信用保险机构给我们的「资信状况」打的分，比去年报表所显示的更高。

words.enDefinition: a person or firm that operates a business under a franchisor’s brand

examples.en: Every franchisee must pass the kitchen audit before the summer season.
examples.zh: 每位「特许证持有人」都必须在夏季旺季前通过后厨审计。

examples.en: The franchisor sued a franchisee for serving coffee from another roaster.
examples.zh: 特许方起诉了一名「特许经营加盟者」，因其使用别家烘焙商的咖啡豆。

words.enDefinition: an upward movement or improvement in activity or prices

examples.en: Bookings are on the upswing since the festival lineup was announced.
examples.zh: 自音乐节阵容公布以来，预订量处于「上升」势头。

examples.en: Analysts expect an upswing in freight rates once factory orders recover.
examples.zh: 分析人士预计，工厂订单回暖后运价将迎来「上升」。

words.enDefinition: to burden an asset with a claim, charge, or restriction

examples.en: The founder's shares are encumbered by a pledge securing last year's bridge loan.
examples.zh: 去年过桥贷款的质押使创始人的股份「背负了债务」。

examples.en: You cannot encumber estate property without the probate court's approval.
examples.zh: 未经遗嘱认证法院批准，不得「使遗产财产负担债务」。

words.enDefinition: payment in cash required immediately on delivery or settlement

examples.en: The wholesaler sells to new shops on cash-on-the-line terms only.
examples.zh: 批发商对新开的店铺只做「货到立即付款」的生意。

examples.en: Veteran stallholders at the fish market still trade strictly cash-on-the-line.
examples.zh: 水产市场上的老摊主们至今仍坚持「货到即付现」。
